0022600110.text: The Pelicans (0-2) are still searching for their first win of the season, sitting 10th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, with a 0-1 road record. The Nuggets (0-1) are also winless, sitting 11th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, and Denver is missing Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Alpha Diallo (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Pelicans lost their 2025-26 season series 0-3, including a 122-116 defeat in New Orleans on January 13, 2026.
